description: This file defines the VTEmailTask class which handles sending emails within the vtiger CRM workflow system. It retrieves email details, renders recipients and content templates, and sends emails accordingly.

classes.name: VTEmailTask
classes.description: A workflow task class responsible for sending emails, extending the VTTask base class.

methods.name: getFieldNames
methods.description: Returns the list of fields relevant for email tasks such as subject, content, recipient, CC, and BCC.

methods.name: doTask
methods.description: Executes the email sending process for a given entity, including template rendering and mail dispatch.
